m: संघाधिप m. (with Jainas) the chief of the brotherhood, Śatr.

a: संघाणकः --कं — The mucus of the nose.

m: संघानन्द m. N. of a patriarch, Buddh.
संघान्न n. food offered from a community, Āpast.
संघाराम m. ‘resting-place for a company (of monks)’, a Buddhist convent or monastery (= विहार), MWB. 428.
सं-घात &c. See s.v.
सं-घात m. (rarely n.; ifc. f(आ). ) striking or dashing together, killing, crushing, MBh.; Suśr.
closing (of a door &c.), VS.; TBr.
combat, war, battle, VS.; Kāṭh.; MBh.
compressing, condensation, compactness, hardening, Yājñ.; Hariv.; Suśr.; VarBṛS.
close union or combination, collection, cluster, heap, mass, multitude, TS.; MBh. &c.
a company of fellow-travellers, caravan, VP.
a collection of mucus, phlegm (cf. संघाणक), L.
a bone, L.
any aggregate of matter, body, Bhag.; Pur.
intensity, R.; Suśr.
a poem composed in one and the same metre, Kāvyād.
(in gram.) a compound as a compact whole (opp. to its single parts), Kāś. on Pāṇ. ii, 3, 56
a vowel with its consonant (opp. to वर्ण, ‘a letter’), Kāty.
(in dram.) a partic. gait or mode of walking, W.
N. of a division of the infernal regions (cf. संहात), Yājñ.; Buddh.
सं-घात &c. See col. 1.
a: संघातः — 1 Union, combination, an association. --2 A multitude, an assemblage, a collection; उपायमंघात इव प्रवृद्धः R. 14. 11; जलसंघात इवासि विद्रुतः Ku. 4. 6. --3 Killing, slaughter. --4 Phlegm. --5 Formation of compounds. --6 N. of a division of bell. --7 A particular mode of walking (in dramas.). --Comp. --कठिन a. hard like a solid, solid; Ku. 2. 11. --शिला a stone-like block or hard mass, solid stone; Ku. 1. 56; 5. 55.

m: सं-घात—शूल-वत् mfn. suffering pain from bodily oppression, Suśr.
सं-घात—चारिन् mfn. living in herds, gregarious, Suśr.
सं-घात—ज mfn. produced by a complicated derangement of the three humours (= संनिपातिक), Bhpr.
सं-˚घातक m. separation of such as keep together, Bhar.
सं-घात—कठिन mfn. hard or firm or solid from compactness, Kum.
सं-˚घातम् ind. dashing together, Kāṭh.
सं-˚घातन n. killing, destroying, HYog.
सं-घात—पर्वत m. N. of two mountains in hell (which open and then close), Jātakam.
सं-घात—पत्त्रिका f. Anethum Sowa, L.
सं-घात—वत् mfn. having close union, closely compacted, dense, Kām.
सं-घात—विहारिन् m. (?) N. of Buddha, Divyāv.
सं-˚घातिका (इका), f. wood of the Ficus Religiosa used for kindling fire by rubbing, L.
सं-˚घात्य m. a kind of dramatic performance, = ˚घातक, Bhar.
संघावशेष m. N. of those sins which are punished with temporary excommunication, Buddh.
सं-घाट m. fitting and joining of timber, joinery, carpentry, R.
a pot (?), Divyāv.
(ifc.) = सं-घात (in पद- and वर्ण-स्˚, qq.vv.)
सं-घाट—सूत्र n. N. of a Buddhist Sūtra.
सं-˚घाटि or सं-˚घाटी, f. a kind of garment, a monk's robe (cf. भिक्षु-स्˚), Suśr.; Divyāv.,
सं-˚घाटिका f. a pair, couple, L.
a woman's garment, Śīl.
procuress, a bawd, L.
Trapa Bispinosa, L.
the nose, L.
a: संघाटिका — 1 A pair, couple. --2 A bawd, procuress. --3 Smell.

m: संघी in comp. for संघ.
संघी—√ भू P. -भवति, to assemble in troops or herds, Kull.

v: pu॰ sam + hana--qa ni॰ । 1 samUhe 2 jantusamUhe ca amara asya vA N । saNGa iti vA rUpam ।
m: सं-घ &c. See s.v.

सं-घ m. (fr. सम् + √ हन्) ‘close contact or combination’, any collection or assemblage, heap, multitude, quantity, crowd, host, number (generally with gen. pl. or ifc., e.g. मुनि-स्˚, ‘a multitude of sages’, BhP.; शत्रु-स्˚, a host of enemies, Rājat.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
any number of people living together for a certain purpose, a society, association, company, community
a clerical community, congregation, church, Mn.; Sāh. &c.
(esp.) the whole community or collective body or brotherhood of monks (with Buddhists; also applied to a monkish fraternity or sect among Jainas), Buddh.; Sarvad.; MWB. 176.
a: संघः — 1 A group, collection, multitude, flock; as महर्षिसंघ, मनुष्यसंघ &c. --2 A number of people living together. --3 Close contact or combination. --चारिन् m. a fish. --जीविन् m. a hired labourer, coolie. --तलः the two hands with the open palms brought together. --वृत्तिः f. close combination.

m: सं-घ—भद्र m. N. of a man, Buddh.
सं-घ—भेद mfn. causing division among the brotherhood (one of the 5 unpardonable sins), Dharmas. 60.
सं-घ—भेदक mfn. one who causes division &c., Buddh.
सं-घ—शस् ind. by troops or numbers, collectively, all together, MBh.; R. &c.
सं-घ—बोधि m. N. of a king of Ceylon (also called Parākrama-bāhu), Buddh.
सं-घ—चारिन् mfn. going in flocks or shoals, gregarious, MBh.; R.
सं-घ—चारिन् m. a fish, L.
सं-घ—दास m. N. of a man, Buddh.
सं-घ—गुह्य m. N. of a man, Buddh.
सं-घ—गुप्त m. N. of the father of Vāg-bhaṭa, Cat. (cf. संघ-पति).
सं-घ—जीविन् mfn. living in company, belonging to a vagrant band, L.
सं-घ—जीविन् m. a hired labourer, porter, cooly, W.
संघक m. a number, multitude, Pañcar.
सं-घ—मित्र m. N. of a poet, Cat.
सं-घ—पति m. the chief of a brotherhood (-त्व n.), Śatr.
N. of the father of Vāg-bhaṭa, Cat. (cf. संघ-गुप्त).
सं-घ—पति—त्व n.
सं-घ—पुरुष m. an attendant on the Buddhist brotherhood, Siṃhās.
सं-घ—पुष्पी f. Grislea Tomentosa, L.
सं-घ—रक्षित and सं-घ—वर्धन, m. N. of men, Buddh.
सं-घर्षा f. liquid lac, L.

v: pu॰ sam + Gfza--GaY । 1 anyonyadfQasaMyoge 2 spardDAyAM 3 saMmardane ca Sabdara॰ vA N ।
m: सं-घर्ष m. rubbing together, friction, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
mutual attrition, rivalry, envy, jealousy in regard to (acc. with प्रति or comp.), ib.
sexual excitement, MBh. (B.) xv, 840 (C. संहर्ष)
going gently, gliding (= सं-सर्प), L.
a: संघर्षः — 1 Rubbing together, friction. --2 Grinding, trituration. --3 Collision, clash. --4 Emulation, rivalry, contest for superiority; तस्याश्च मम च कस्तिंश्चित्संघर्षे Dk.; नाट्याचार्ययोर्महान् ज्ञानसंघर्षो जातः M. 1. --5 Envy, jealousy. --6 Gliding, gently flowing.

m: सं-˚घर्षण n. rubbing together or against each other, Pur.
any substance used for rubbing in, ointment, unguent, MBh.
सं-घर्ष—शालिन् mfn. envious, jealous, Kathās.
सं-˚घर्षयितृ m. a rival, Sāy. on RV. x, 18, 9.
सं-˚घर्षिन् mfn. rubbing together, emulating, rivalling, vying with one another or with regard to (comp.), MBh.
jealous, envious, Śiś.
सं-घस m. food, victuals, Bhaṭṭ.
सं-घ—तल m. = संह-त्˚ (q.v.)
संघतिथ mfn. numerous, abundant, Śiś. (cf. Pāṇ. v, 2, 52).
सं-घ—वृत्ति f. a league, alliance, Viddh.
सं-घ—वृत्ति—ता f. combined action, MW.

सं-√ घट् Ā. -घटते, to assemble together, meet, Rājat.; to meet, encounter, Siṃhās. : Caus. -घाटयति or -घटयति, to cause to assemble, collect, Kathās.; to join or fasten together, Sarvad.; to strike (a musical instrument), R. : Intens. -जाघटीति, to be well fitted or adapted for anything, ib.
a: संघट् — {c1c} A. To meet, assemble together. --Caus. 1 To join or fasten together, bring together. --2 To strike (a musical instrument), sound, play upon.

m: सं-घट mf(आ)n. heaped, piled up, AgP.
सं-˚घटक (used for explaining संधि), TBr., Sch.
सं-˚घटना (आ), f. combination of words or sounds, Sāh.
a: संघटना — Joining together, union, combination; Ratn. 4. 20.

m: सं-˚घटन n. (or f(आ). ) union or junction with (comp.), Vcar.; Ratnāv.; Sāh.
सं-घटित mfn. assembled together, met &c.
struck (as a musical instrument), R.

सं-√ घट्ट् Ā. -घट्टते, to strike or clasp or rub together, knead, crush to pieces, bruise, R. : Caus. -घट्टयति (ind.p. -घट्टय्य), to cause to rub against (instr.), Ragh.; to stir, AgP.; to strike against, touch, MBh.; to cause to sound by striking, R.; to bring together, collect, assemble, MBh.; Rājat.; to meet, encounter, Naiṣ.
a: संघट्ट् — {c1c} A. 1 To strike. --2 To bring together, unite. --3 To gather, collect. --4 To rub, rub against or press against; संघदृयन्नंगदमंगदेन R. 6. 73. --5 To strike against, touch.

m: सं-घट्टा (), f. a large creeper (= लता), L.

v: pu॰ sam + Gawwa--BAve ac । 1 anyonyavimarde 2 gaWane ca “mfdAharaRasaMGawwa pratiQAhvAnameva ca” ti॰ ta॰ । 3 latAyA strI Sabdaca॰ । lyuw । tatrArTe na॰ ।
m: सं-घट्ट m. rubbing or clashing together, friction, collision, conflict, rivalry, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a stroke (in हृदय-स्˚, q.v.)
junction or union with (instr.), Naiṣ.
embracing, W.
a: संघट्टः — 1 Friction, rubbing together; सरलस्कंधसंघट्टजन्मा (दवाग्नः) Me. 53; Māl. 5. 3, 9. 1. --2 Collision, clashing together, encounter; Śi. 20. 26. --3 Encounter, conflict. --4 Meeting, joining, collision or rivalry (as of wives); R. 14. 86. --5 Embracing. --ट्टा A large creeper.

m: सं-घट्ट—चक्र n. a partic. astrological diagram (for determining the proper season for war), Cat.
सं-˚घट्टन m. a kind of spectral being or phantom, Hariv.
सं-˚घट्टन n. rubbing together, Prasannar.
friction, collision, Rājat.
सं-˚घट्टन n. meeting, encountering, close contact or union (as the intertwining of wrestlers, the embrace of lovers &c.), ib.; Vet.; Sāh.; Pratāp. (also f(आ). ; often v.l. or w.r. for सं-घटन).
a: संघट्टनं --ना — 1 Rubbing together, friction. --2 Collision, clash. --3 Close contact, adherence to. --4 Contact, union, cohesion. --5 The intertwining of wrestlers. --6 Meeting, encounter in general. --7 The embrace of lovers.

m: सं-घट्ट—पणित n. a wager, Hcar.
सं-˚घट्टिन् m. (incorrect for सं-घटिन्) an adherent, follower, BhP.
सं-घट्टित mfn. rubbed or struck together or against &c.
kneaded, Pañcat. iii, 236 (v.l.)
collected, assembled, MBh.
सं-घट्टित m. du. (with पाणी) the joined hands of bride and husband, Prasannar. (perhaps w.r. for सम्-घटित).

सं-√ घृष् P. -घर्षति, to rub together or against each other, contend or vie with (instr.), MBh.; Ragh. : Pass. -घृष्यते, to be rubbed or wetted (as a sword), Subh.; (pr. p. -घृष्यत्), to be brought or come into collision, vie or rival with (also with परस्-परम्), MBh.
a: संघृष् — {c1c} P. 1 To rub or grind together. --2 To rival, emulate, compete or vie with; स प्रयोगनिपुणैः प्रयोक्तृभिः संजघर्ष सह मिवसंनिधौ R. 19. 36. --3 To rub, scratch.

m: सं-घृष्ट mfn. rubbed with, rubbed together, MBh.
सं-घोष m. a station of herdsmen (= घोष), MārkP.
सं-˚घोषिणी f. a partic. class of demons, Siṃhās.
सं-√ घ्रा Caus. -घ्रापयति, to bring into close connection or intimacy, make intimate, ŚBr.

a: संघुष् — {c1c} P. 1 To resound. --2 To proclaim loudly.

m: सं-घुषित mfn. (√ घुष्) sounded, proclaimed, Pāṇ. vii, 2, 28, Sch.
सं-घुषित n. sound, noise, cry, Bhaṭṭ.
सं-˚घुष्ट mfn. sounded, resonant, MBh.; Hariv.
proclaimed, Pāṇ. vii, 2, 28, Sch.
offered for sale, Yājñ. i, 168
सं-˚घुष्ट m. sound, noise, W.
a: संघुष्ट — p. p. 1 Resonant, resounding. --2 Sounded, proclaimed. --3 Offered for sale. --ष्टः A sound, noise.

m: सं-˚घुष्टक mfn. suited or accustomed to each other, Pat. on Pāṇ. i, 1, 50, Vārtt. 8.
